parameters.name: container
parameters.description: The container to observe. Use a callback ref backed by state to track when it mounts or changes.

parameters.name: anchor
parameters.description: The visible element whose viewport position should be preserved. Use a callback ref backed by state. Only window scrolling is adjusted.

parameters.name: anchorKey
parameters.description: A stable identity for the anchor, used to preserve its position if its DOM element is replaced. Changing the key starts a new baseline.
